root_cause.statement: PostgreSQL validates a LANGUAGE sql function's body against the catalog AT CREATE FUNCTION TIME. LANGUAGE plpgsql defers this (lazy binding, validated only at first execution). This is a real, documented PostgreSQL behavior difference this project's earlier Phase 4/9 analysis did not account for -- it generalized plpgsql's lazy-binding behavior to 'functions can be created in any order', which is true for plpgsql but false for LANGUAGE sql.
root_cause.both_are: LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER, and both reference objects deliberately excluded from the minimal F-10 bootstrap for RUNTIME reasons (public.platform_roles, public.workspace_memberships, auth.uid() -- all reachable ONLY through the one workspaces_member_select RLS policy, which does not even exist as executable SQL in this bootstrap, and which F-10's real BYPASSRLS service_role transport bypasses entirely).
